why: DECISION #30 — openai_compatible provider. Coded against THIS captured shape, not memory (standing rule 1).

reasoning_effort_rejected.finding: OpenAI-only field. Ollama 400s on reasoning_effort='minimal'. The openai_compatible adapter MUST NOT send it.

max_completion_tokens_IGNORED.finding: Cap of 5 produced 152 tokens, finish_reason 'stop'. NOT honored -> unbounded output.

max_tokens_HONORED.finding: Honored: finish_reason 'length'. openai_compatible MUST send max_tokens, not max_completion_tokens.

seam1_structured_output.finding: SUPPORTED. Same wire shape as OpenAI: choices[0].message.content + usage.prompt_tokens/completion_tokens.

seam2_tool_calls_UNSUPPORTED_phi4mini.content_head: The "probe token" referred to in your request seems like a specific identifier or key used within an API, service, or system that requires authentication for ce
seam2_tool_calls_UNSUPPORTED_phi4mini.finding: SILENTLY ignores tools: finish_reason 'stop', no tool_calls, confident prose instead. THE failure mode -> chat must degrade explicitly.

tool_choice_required_UNRELIABLE.finding: tool_choice:'required' NOT honored - the tool-CAPABLE model degraded to hallucinating a call as text. Probe must use tool_choice:'auto', matching production.

unknown_model.finding: 404 + error.message. Probe surfaces this as a plain-English 'model not found at this endpoint'.

keyless_no_auth_header.finding: 200 without any Authorization header -> API key is optional; omit the header entirely when absent.
